Pages.title: 龙舌兰
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): 12°C - 40°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)湿度$(): 5 - 45 %$(br)$(bold)类别$(): 蔬菜类$(br2)$(bold)$(3)氮$(): 30 $(bold)$(6)磷$(): 20 $(bold)$(d)钾$(): 50$()$(br2)种子（侧芽）播在$(l:tfc:food/farmland)农田$()上。莲座分六龄生长，完全成熟并显现中心结果态后，破坏整株采收并返还1至2份侧芽；空手右键不采摘。枯死时在原地返还1份对应侧芽，应及时拾取；之后破坏共享死株不再掉落。$(br2)
龙舌兰的六个叶片生长阶段与完全成熟后的中心结果态；最后一帧才可收获产物。

Pages.title: 野生龙舌兰
Pages.text: 可在下列区域找到：$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): 12°C - 40°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)降水$(): 20 - 180mm$(br2)采到的种子播在$(l:tfc:farming_plus/crops)农田$()上即可栽培；栽培条件为温度 12°C - 40°C、湿度 5 - 45 %。

Pages.title: Agave
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 12°C - 40°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)Hydration$(): 5 - 45 %$(br)$(bold)Category$(): Vegetable$(br2)$(bold)$(3)Nitrogen$(): 30 $(bold)$(6)Phosphorous$(): 20 $(bold)$(d)Potassium$(): 50$()$(br2)Sow seeds (sidebuds) on $(l:tfc:food/farmland)farmland$(). This rosette has six leaf stages. Once fully grown with a ripe centre, break the whole plant to harvest and receive one to two sidebuds; an empty-hand right-click does not harvest. When it dies, one species sidebud drops immediately: collect it promptly. Breaking the shared dead plant gives nothing further.$(br2)
The six leaf stages of Agave and its fully mature fruiting centre; only the final frame yields the harvest.

Pages.text: Can be found in regions with: $(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 12°C - 40°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)Rainfall$(): 20 - 180mm$(br2)Seeds collected here can be sown on $(l:tfc:farming_plus/crops)farmland$(); as a crop it needs temperature 12°C - 40°C and hydration 5 - 45 %.

Pages.title: 向日葵
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): 5°C - 30°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)湿度$(): 20 - 70 %$(br)$(bold)类别$(): 蔬菜类$(br2)$(bold)$(3)氮$(): 80 $(bold)$(6)磷$(): +30 $(bold)$(d)钾$(): +40$()$(br2)向日葵是双格作物。高秆大头，花盘随日而转，籽可榨油。$(br2)种子播在$(l:tfc:food/farmland)农田$()上，上方留空供植株长高。完全成熟后破坏任意半株收获并返种，只结算一次。$(br2)
向日葵在农田上的 6 个生长阶段。后几个阶段会向上长高，占上下两格。

Pages.title: 野生向日葵
Pages.text: 可在下列区域找到：$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): 5°C - 30°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)降水$(): 80 - 280mm$(br2)采到的种子播在$(l:tfc:farming_plus/crops)农田$()上即可栽培；栽培条件为温度 5°C - 30°C、湿度 20 - 70 %。

Pages.title: Sunflower
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): 5°C - 30°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)Hydration$(): 20 - 70 %$(br)$(bold)Category$(): Vegetable$(br2)$(bold)$(3)Nitrogen$(): 80 $(bold)$(6)Phosphorous$(): +30 $(bold)$(d)Potassium$(): +40$()$(br2)Sunflower is a two-block crop: a tall stalk crowned by a great disc that follows the sun.$(br2)Sow on $(l:tfc:food/farmland)farmland$() with space above for the upper plant. Once fully grown, break either half to harvest and return seeds once.$(br2)
The 6 growth stages of Sunflower on farmland. The later stages grow a second block tall.

Pages.title: Beans and oilseeds
Pages.text: Existing beans, sesame, safflower and sunflower harvests retain their food data and vegetable-tag access to native soup, salads and sandwiches. Equipment and food rules still apply.$(br2)Dedicated oil extraction is not connected; these crops do not become canola paste. Project bowl dough rejects rotten ingredients and carries input food history using TFC rules.

Pages.title: 大黄
Pages.text: $(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)温度$(): -12°C - 24°C$(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:food/hydration)湿度$(): 45 - 85 %$(br)$(bold)类别$(): 可采摘蔬菜$(br2)$(bold)$(3)氮$(): 50 $(bold)$(6)磷$(): 20 $(bold)$(d)钾$(): 30$()$(br2)大黄是$(thing)可采摘蔬菜$()。叶柄酸得厉害，能吃的只有这一部分。$(br2)种子播在$(l:tfc:food/farmland)农田$()上，生长后期空手右键采摘可保留植株；左键破坏会拔除植株。$(br2)
